On this device, the keyboard counts the corrections you undo or keep, the words you accept and the email addresses you type, so it can adapt to you and suggest your addresses as soon as you start typing one. Only word and correction counters, and your email addresses, are kept, encrypted, never sentences. Nothing is counted in sensitive fields or in private browsing; email addresses are also remembered in address fields, never in password fields.
Everything the keyboard has counted about your corrections, words and email addresses will be deleted. This can\'t be undone.
This helps us improve the app. You can turn it off at any time.

Export or restore my dictionary, pinned items and settings

To switch devices, export your data to a file, then restore it on the new device. The file contains your personal dictionary, your pinned Smart Clipboard items (with their labels) and your settings (keyboard, chosen model, custom prompts). It does not contain the AI models, which must be downloaded again, nor the clipboard history, nor what the keyboard has learned from your typing.
Saves a file to the location of your choice, on the device or in online storage.

The file is not encrypted: anyone who opens it can read your dictionary and pinned items, which may contain personal information (addresses, numbers, canned messages). Keep it somewhere safe and delete it once the restore is done.

What stays on your device and what connects

Correction, text generation, voice input and AI transcription run on your device using locally installed models. The text you type, copy or dictate and the audio of your recordings are not sent to any server. The audio of an AI transcription stays in memory while it is processed: it is never saved to a file.

Taipo connects to the Internet to download AI model files, at your request: from a Junadé server for the Gemma 3 models and the voice input models, and from Hugging Face for the Gemma 4 models. These servers receive the usual technical information of a connection (IP address, requested file), never your text or your recordings. Unless you turn it off in the keyboard settings, Taipo also sends anonymous usage analytics to Aptabase, a European service (see section 3). From time to time, Taipo may also offer to let you leave a review: this window is displayed by Google Play, which receives your rating and comment; Taipo does not receive them.

Taipo has no account and no ads. It measures its usage anonymously with Aptabase: events such as “an AI correction succeeded”, “a model was downloaded” or “a setting changed”, along with the app version, the Android version, the device model and its language. Never your text, what you copy or dictate, or any identifier of the device or the person, and nothing from password fields. As with any Internet connection, Aptabase\'s servers technically receive the IP address of the request; Taipo itself never sees it or stores it (see Aptabase\'s privacy policy for how it is handled). You can turn it off at any time in Keyboard settings > Usage data. Taipo itself collects no personal data about you.
In a password or secret code field, AI actions (Correct, Generate, Voice, AI transcription) and the Smart Clipboard are disabled: the field\'s content is not read and the microphone is not opened.
5. What is stored on the device

Your personal dictionary, Smart Clipboard items and settings stay on your device, in encrypted databases. Uninstalling the app deletes this data. You can also export it to an unencrypted file (My data > Backup and restore): this file only leaves the device if you move it yourself.
Rules for using Taipo and the AI
Taipo is an Android keyboard that offers artificial intelligence features (correction, text generation, voice input) running on your device. By enabling or using Taipo, you accept these terms.
The text you type, copy or dictate stays on your device: Taipo does not send it to any server. Internet access is used only to download an AI model file, at your request.

The correction and generation models are Google Gemma models. Gemma 3 (Ultra-light and Light) is provided under the Gemma Terms of Use; Gemma 4 (Balanced and Powerful) is provided under the Apache 2.0 license. The texts and links are in the “Licenses” screen.

You agree not to use Taipo\'s AI features for any use prohibited by the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy (ai.google.dev/gemma/prohibited_use_policy), which forms part of these terms. Google may update this policy: the online version prevails. If you pass a Gemma 3 model on to a third party, you must impose these same restrictions on them and inform them that they apply. In all cases, you agree to comply with applicable law.
An AI model may produce inaccurate, incomplete or inappropriate text. Always review generated or corrected text before sending it: you remain responsible for what you write and send with Taipo.
Taipo and the AI models are provided “as is”, with no guarantee of results, to the extent permitted by law. Your statutory rights are not affected.
These terms may change with new versions of Taipo; the date of the last update is shown at the top of this screen.
